rubriker.title: International conference "Chess in Education" to b­­e held in Almaty
rubriker._rss_content: Almaty will host the 4th International Scientific and Practical Conference "Chess in Education" on 12–13 November at Narxoz University. Organised as part of Kazakhstan's national chess development plan, the event will focus on expanding school chess, improving teacher training and integrating chess more systematically into education. FIDE President Timur Turlov and international specialists will join discussions on cognitive development, curriculum design, digital tools and the training of educators. | Image: FIDE

rubriker.title: A chess revival at Simpson's-in-the-Strand
rubriker._rss_content: The London chess café Simpson's-in-the-Strand was, for a time, a meeting place for the world's leading players. Now, thanks to Jeremy King and Jason Kouchak, the historic venue is enjoying a revival not only as a top restaurant but also as a gathering place for chess enthusiasts. | Photos: Chiao Lee

rubriker.title: Lhamsuren Myagmarsuren (1938-2026)
rubriker._rss_content: Bobby Fischer fans in particular will probably be familiar with the name Lhamsuren Myagmarsuren. At the Interzonal Tournament in Sousse 1967, Fischer defeated him in a brilliant game that is still frequently cited. On 26 October, the multiple Mongolian champion, who represented his country on numerous occasions, died at the age of 88. | Foto: https://montsame.mn/

rubriker.title: Clutch Chess: Champions Showdown 2026 - Games and results
rubriker._rss_content: The Clutch Chess: Champions Showdown took place Tue 27th Oct 2026 to 29th Oct 2026. The idea of the event is to have increasing scores from day 1 to day 3 so that the scoring is volatile and likely there will be something to play for right to the end. Javokhir Sindarov won the event with a draw in the final round, if Praggnanandhaa had won he would have taken the event. That said the players finished in exactly the order they would have finished with standard scoring.

rubriker.title: Sindarov gana el Clutch Chess Champions Showdown, su último torneo antes del match ante Gukesh
rubriker._rss_content: Javokhir Sindarov se proclamó campeón del «Clutch Chess: Champions Showdown» en Saint Louis tras remontar una desventaja de 2½ puntos en la última jornada. El gran maestro uzbeko consiguió tres victorias y tres tablas el jueves, incluida una brillante victoria con negras ante Hikaru Nakamura en una Defensa India de Rey. Praggnanandhaa Rameshbabu terminó segundo, a 1½ puntos del ganador. Sindarov suma así un nuevo triunfo a menos de un mes de su encuentro por el Campeonato del Mundo contra Gukesh Dommaraju en Ginebra. | Foto: Lennart Ootes / Saint Louis Chess Club

rubriker.title: El ajedrez como patrimonio cultural inmaterial: argumentos históricos y educativos
rubriker._rss_content: El ajedrez puede entenderse no solo como juego y deporte, sino también como una tradición cultural transmitida y recreada durante siglos. El texto defiende su consideración como patrimonio cultural inmaterial a partir de su historia intercultural, su lenguaje propio, su memoria colectiva y su valor educativo. Al mismo tiempo, subraya que este reconocimiento exige preservar comunidades, prácticas y formas de transmisión, sin convertir una tradición viva en una pieza de museo. | Imagen (IA): Uvencio Blanco
